Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for a wilderness making/combination game.
Create ONE transparent sprite sheet, exactly FIVE columns and FOUR rows, 20 separate icon cells in strict reading order. Canvas 1600x1280 if possible, each cell same size. Center each complete object inside its cell with at least 12% empty padding to every cell boundary. NO drawn grid, labels, letters, numbers, captions, shadows outside cells or overlapping objects. Every cell must have only its specified subject. Source art will be cropped into 224px PNG icons and viewed at about 56px, so simplify while keeping identifying details.
Style: Limited-palette risograph printed object catalogue: expressive asymmetrical silhouettes, dry granular ink, slightly misregistered vermilion, mustard yellow and deep petrol black with sage accent; no digital gradients; bold irregular outline, playful but grown-up. Natural proportions; no circular badges, transparent outside each object.
The supplied image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target; use its print language but draw the NEW subjects below.
Read order, exactly:
1. Telescope: long tapered brass optical tube, visible dark glass lens, angled diagonally; no tripod
2. Pendulum: a single heavy round metal bob suspended from a long thin rod, pivot at top, small curved swing marks; no clock face
3. Clockwork: open mechanical assembly of three interlocking toothed gears and escapement in a simple wooden frame; no clock face
4. Botanical drawing: one rectangular sheet of cream paper carrying a clearly drawn branching leafy specimen and small detail studies; no lettering
5. Bread: rustic scored round brown loaf with one cut slice
6. Porridge: shallow earthen bowl of lumpy creamy oat porridge, wooden spoon resting inside
7. Feast table: sturdy low wooden table laden with loaf, fruit, bowl and jug, visible table legs
8. Cider: earthen pitcher with amber drink in small cup and TWO unmistakable apples beside it; no grapes, no wine bottle
9. Brick: one red clay rectangular construction brick, crisp rectangular silhouette
10. Iron: two dull charcoal-grey metal ingots, angular trapezoidal cast shapes with bright edge
11. Thread: small wooden spool wound with fine red thread, thin loose trailing strand
12. Brine: shallow salt-glazed blue-grey bowl of blue water with white salt crust around rim, separate small white salt crystals beside bowl; no spoon
13. Smoke: dark grey rising three curling wisps, no flame, no cloud at ground
14. Earth: low mound of loose rich brown soil with small clods and root fragments, no planet, no growing plant
15. Air: three long clear pale-blue horizontal curling wind strokes, much longer and lighter than smoke, no cloud
16. Plant: small green leafy living seedling with visible roots, no flower
17. Flower: one open red wildflower bloom on green stem with two leaves
18. House: simple cutaway thatched hut, blank square window opening on left wall, open doorway/interior at right with bare floor; no installed window, no mat
19. Window: separate wooden four-pane window frame with blue glass, front view
20. Sleeping mat: unrolled woven rush sleeping mat, long rectangle, small rolled head edge, no pillow
Keep all twenty subjects distinct, consistent visual weight and linework. Fully transparent space between cells.
